product_launches.description: cargo.one launched what it calls the sector’s first AI-native multimodal freight operating system, unifying air and ocean data to enable autonomous logistics workflows on a single platform.

overview_description.description: cargo.one is the digital platform for freight forwarders to search, compare and book air freight capacities across airlines. These airlines benefit from a fully digital and data driven distribution channel, attracting new business at lower cost and higher operational efficiency. cargo.one has attracted leading airlines and forwarders including Lufthansa, Finnair, AirBridgeCargo, Etihad, ANA, Expeditors, Kühne + Nagel, DSV Panalpina, Hellmann, Flexport and JAS to distribute and buy air cargo online.  cargo.one is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Creandum, Point Nine Capital, Next47 and Lufthansa Cargo. about_short_description.short_description: cargo.one is a digital platform designed for freight forwarders to search, compare, and book air freight capacities across airlines.

product.name: cargo.one pro
product.description: A cloud-based air freight sales and operations platform for forwarders to search rates, generate quotes, compare capacity, book shipments, and manage partner-agent business.

product.name: Airline Rates
product.description: A rate-search and booking service that lets freight forwarders compare and book live, contract, promotional, and standard air freight rates from participating airlines.

product.name: Agent Rates
product.description: A service for finding, comparing, and booking real-time air freight rates and local origin or destination charges from partner agents for different Incoterms.

product.name: Quoting
product.description: A digital quoting tool that uses smart templates to create professional customer quotes, including door-to-door pricing, in seconds.

product.name: Storefront
product.description: An automated digital sales portal where freight forwarders publish rates and local charges so partner agents can view, quote, and book their offers online.

product.name: Insights
product.description: An analytics and benchmarking product that uses real-time quotation and market data to evaluate sales conversion, procurement performance, rates, and shipment outcomes.
